import os
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from openai import OpenAI
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate
from azure.cosmos import CosmosClient

class DocumentClients:
    def __init__(self):
        # Azure Document Intelligence Client
        self.azure_document_intelligence_endpoint = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
        self.azure_document_intelligence_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")
        if self.azure_document_intelligence_endpoint and self.azure_document_intelligence_key:
            self.document_intelligence_client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(
                endpoint=self.azure_document_intelligence_endpoint,
                credential=AzureKeyCredential(self.azure_document_intelligence_key)
            )
        else:
            self.document_intelligence_client = None

        # OpenAI Client
        self.openai_api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
        if self.openai_api_key:
            self.openai_client = OpenAI(api_key=self.openai_api_key)
        else:
            self.openai_client = None

        # Google Cloud Translation Client
        # GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable should be set for authentication
        try:
            self.google_translate_client = translate.Client()
        except Exception:
            self.google_translate_client = None

        # Azure Cosmos DB Client
        self.azure_cosmos_endpoint = os.environ.get("AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT")
        self.azure_cosmos_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_COSMOS_KEY")
        self.azure_cosmos_database_name = os.environ.get("AZURE_COSMOS_DATABASE_NAME")
        self.azure_cosmos_container_name = os.environ.get("AZURE_COSMOS_CONTAINER_NAME")
        if self.azure_cosmos_endpoint and self.azure_cosmos_key and self.azure_cosmos_database_name and self.azure_cosmos_container_name:
            self.cosmos_client = CosmosClient(self.azure_cosmos_endpoint, self.azure_cosmos_key)
            self.cosmos_database = self.cosmos_client.get_database_client(self.azure_cosmos_database_name)
            self.cosmos_container = self.cosmos_database.get_container_client(self.azure_cosmos_container_name)
        else:
            self.cosmos_client = None
            self.cosmos_database = None
            self.cosmos_container = None

    clients = DocumentClients()

        raise ValueError("Azure Document Intelligence client not initialized.")

        "prebuilt-invoice", invoice_document, content_type="application/pdf"

                invoice_fields.currency = doc.fields.get("Currency") and doc.fields["Currency"].content
                invoice_fields.invoice_id = doc.fields.get("InvoiceId") and doc.fields["InvoiceId"].content
                invoice_fields.customer_name = doc.fields.get("CustomerName") and doc.fields["CustomerName"].content
                invoice_fields.customer_address = doc.fields.get("CustomerAddress") and doc.fields["CustomerAddress"].content
                invoice_fields.vendor_address = doc.fields.get("VendorAddress") and doc.fields["VendorAddress"].content
                invoice_fields.purchase_order = doc.fields.get("PurchaseOrder") and doc.fields["PurchaseOrder"].content
                invoice_fields.due_date = doc.fields.get("DueDate") and doc.fields["DueDate"].content
                invoice_fields.tax_amount = doc.fields.get("TotalTax") and doc.fields["TotalTax"].value
                invoice_fields.service_start_date = doc.fields.get("ServiceStartDate") and doc.fields["ServiceStartDate"].content
                invoice_fields.service_end_date = doc.fields.get("ServiceEndDate") and doc.fields["ServiceEndDate"].content
                invoice_fields.billing_address = doc.fields.get("BillingAddress") and doc.fields["BillingAddress"].content
                invoice_fields.shipping_address = doc.fields.get("ShippingAddress") and doc.fields["ShippingAddress"].content
                invoice_fields.payment_terms = doc.fields.get("PaymentTerms") and doc.fields["PaymentTerms"].content
                invoice_fields.vat_number = doc.fields.get("VatNumber") and doc.fields["VatNumber"].content
                invoice_fields.vendor_tax_id = doc.fields.get("VendorTaxId") and doc.fields["VendorTaxId"].content
                invoice_fields.customer_tax_id = doc.fields.get("CustomerTaxId") and doc.fields["CustomerTaxId"].content
                invoice_fields.bank_account_number = doc.fields.get("BankAccountNumber") and doc.fields["BankAccountNumber"].content
                invoice_fields.swift_code = doc.fields.get("SwiftCode") and doc.fields["SwiftCode"].content
                invoice_fields.iban_number = doc.fields.get("IbanNumber") and doc.fields["IbanNumber"].content
                invoice_fields.notes = doc.fields.get("Notes") and doc.fields["Notes"].content
                invoice_fields.memo = doc.fields.get("Memo") and doc.fields["Memo"].content

                # Extract line items
                if "Items" in doc.fields:
                    for item in doc.fields["Items"].value:
                        line_item = LineItem(
                            description=item.get("Description") and item["Description"].content,

                        )
                        invoice_fields.line_items.append(line_item)
    return invoice_fields

            "invoice_total": extracted_document.invoice_total,
            "currency": extracted_document.currency,
            "line_items": [
                {
                    "description": item.description,
                    "quantity": item.quantity,
                    "unit_price": item.unit_price,
                    "total_price": item.total_price,
                }
                for item in extracted_document.line_items
            ]
        }
    elif isinstance(extracted_document, Receipt):
        doc_data = {
            "merchant_name": extracted_document.merchant_name,
            "transaction_date": extracted_document.transaction_date,
            "transaction_time": extracted_document.transaction_time,
            "total_amount": extracted_document.total_amount,
            "tax_amount": extracted_document.tax_amount,
            "currency": extracted_document.currency,
            "line_items": [
                {
                    "description": item.description,
                    "quantity": item.quantity,
                    "unit_price": item.unit_price,
                    "total_price": item.total_price,
                }
                for item in extracted_document.line_items
            ]
        }
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported document type for normalization.")

    normalized_schema = NormalizedExpense(
        transaction_id="", # This will be generated later or by DB
        document_type=document_type,
        transaction_date="",
        vendor_merchant_name="",
        total_amount=0.0,
        currency="",
        tax_amount=0.0,
        category="",
        description="",
        line_items=[],
        raw_document_data=doc_data,
        validation_status="pending",
        validation_details={},
        notes="",
        memo=""
    )

    prompt = f"""Normalize the following extracted document data into the provided JSON schema. \n\nExtracted Document Data: {json.dumps(doc_data, indent=2)}\n\nTarget Schema for NormalizedExpense (Python dataclass structure provided, convert to JSON):\n{json.dumps({
    "transaction_id": "UUID or identifier",
    "document_type": "invoice" if document_type == "invoice" else "receipt",
    "transaction_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "vendor_merchant_name": "Name of vendor or merchant",
    "total_amount": "Total amount with 2 decimal places",
    "currency": "Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR)",
    "tax_amount": "Tax amount with 2 decimal places",
    "category": "Suggested category (e.g., Travel, Food, Office Supplies)",
    "description": "Brief description of the expense",
    "line_items": [
        {{"description": "Item description", "quantity": 1.0, "unit_price": 10.00, "total_price": 10.00}}
    ],
    "raw_document_data": {{...}}, # The original extracted data
    "validation_status": "pending",
    "validation_details": {{}},
    "notes": "Any relevant notes from the document",
    "memo": "Any memo from the document",
}, indent=2)}\n\nReturn ONLY the JSON object for NormalizedExpense. Do not include any other text or formatting. Fill in all applicable fields from the extracted document data. If a field is not present, use a sensible default or null. For \'description\', provide a concise summary of the transaction. For \'category\', infer a suitable category from the merchant/vendor name or line items. Ensure currency is consistent if multiple currencies appear, prioritize total currency. All monetary values should be floats. Ensure transaction_date is in YYYY-MM-DD format. If line items are missing from source, provide an empty list.  If 'notes' or 'memo' exist in the original document, include them.
"""

    chat_completion = clients.openai_client.chat.completions.create(
        model="gpt-4o-mini", # Using a more capable model for structured output

        response_format={ "type": "json_object" }
    )

    normalized_json = json.loads(chat_completion.choices[0].message.content)

        transaction_id=normalized_json.get("transaction_id"),

from document_client import DocumentClients
from document_models import NormalizedExpense
import json
from typing import Dict, Any

def validate_document_fields(expense_record: NormalizedExpense) -> NormalizedExpense:
    clients = DocumentClients()
    if not clients.openai_client:
        raise ValueError("OpenAI client not initialized.")

    required_fields = [
        "transaction_date",
        "vendor_merchant_name",
        "total_amount",
        "currency",
        "document_type",
    ]
    validation_results: Dict[str, Any] = {"missing_fields": [], "invalid_data": []}
    overall_status = "completed"

    # Basic structural validation first
    for field in required_fields:
        if not getattr(expense_record, field):
            validation_results["missing_fields"].append(field)
            overall_status = "failed"

    # Use OpenAI to perform more nuanced validation based on content and common sense
    prompt = f"""Review the following normalized expense record (JSON representation). Identify any potential issues such as inconsistent data, implausible values (e.g., negative amounts for total_amount or tax_amount, dates in the future for transaction_date), or formatting errors. Also, check if the document type is consistent with the presence of vendor/merchant names. For line items, check if total_price is consistent with quantity * unit_price. Provide a JSON object with a 'status' (either 'passed' or 'failed') and 'details' which is a list of strings describing any issues found. If no issues, 'details' should be an empty list.\n\nExpense Record: {json.dumps(expense_record.__dict__, default=str, indent=2)}\n"""

    chat_completion = clients.openai_client.chat.completions.create(
        model="gpt-4o-mini", # Using a capable model for validation
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "You are an AI assistant that validates structured expense records. You output ONLY a JSON object with a 'status' and 'details' field."},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
        ],
        response_format={ "type": "json_object" }
    )

    llm_validation_output = json.loads(chat_completion.choices[0].message.content)

    if llm_validation_output.get("status") == "failed":
        overall_status = "failed"
        validation_results["invalid_data"].extend(llm_validation_output.get("details", []))

    expense_record.validation_status = overall_status
    expense_record.validation_details = validation_results

    return expense_record

from document_client import DocumentClients

import json

def summarize_invoice(invoice: Invoice) -> str:
    clients = DocumentClients()
    if not clients.openai_client:
        raise ValueError("OpenAI client not initialized.")

    invoice_data = {
        "vendor_name": invoice.vendor_name,
        "invoice_date": invoice.invoice_date,
        "invoice_total": invoice.invoice_total,
        "currency": invoice.currency,
        "line_items": [
            {
                "description": item.description,
                "quantity": item.quantity,
                "unit_price": item.unit_price,
                "total_price": item.total_price,
            }
            for item in invoice.line_items
        ],
        "notes": invoice.notes,
        "memo": invoice.memo
    }

    prompt = f"""Summarize the key information from the following invoice data. Focus on the vendor, total amount, date, and a brief overview of line items. Keep the summary concise and informative.\n\nInvoice Data: {json.dumps(invoice_data, indent=2)}"""

        model="gpt-4o-mini", # Using a capable model for summarization
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "You are an AI assistant that summarizes invoice data."},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
        ]
    )

    summary = chat_completion.choices[0].message.content
    return summary

from document_client import DocumentClients
from document_models import NormalizedExpense
import uuid

def persist_expense_record(expense_record: NormalizedExpense) -> str:
    clients = DocumentClients()
    if not clients.cosmos_container:
        raise ValueError("Azure Cosmos DB client not initialized or container not configured.")

    if not expense_record.transaction_id:
        expense_record.transaction_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    # Convert dataclass to dictionary for Cosmos DB
    item = expense_record.__dict__
    # Convert line_items from list of LineItem dataclasses to list of dicts
    if item.get("line_items"):
        item["line_items"] = [li.__dict__ for li in item["line_items"]]

    # Cosmos DB requires 'id' field for document identification
    item["id"] = expense_record.transaction_id

    clients.cosmos_container.create_item(body=item)

    return expense_record.transaction_id
